rows.claim: 2026Q1 revenue was CNY13.138bn and parent net profit was CNY1.11bn.
rows.evidence: Official Q1 report and local financial packet agree.
rows.formal_boundary: Company-level reported result; no product-level attribution is implied.
rows.model_impact: Sets the 2026 starting run-rate and seasonality check.
rows.gap: H1 result was not formally disclosed by the cutoff.

rows.claim: Source Photonics accounted for 16.02% of Q1 revenue and 52.92% of Q1 profit.
rows.evidence: The company disclosed the ratios in the abnormal movement announcement.
rows.formal_boundary: Ratios are company disclosure; absolute segment amounts are derived by multiplication.
rows.model_impact: Supports segment split and optical earnings credit.
rows.gap: Q1 product and customer mix remains undisclosed.

rows.claim: 2025 optical module revenue was CNY1.436bn with 36.74% gross margin.
rows.formal_boundary: Only post-consolidation period is included in the 2025 consolidated product table.
rows.model_impact: Anchors optical gross-profit quality, not full-year 2026 revenue.
rows.gap: No 2025 full-year standalone optical disclosure in the annual report.

rows.claim: A USD1.2bn optical expansion was approved.
rows.formal_boundary: Capacity investment is not equal to orders, utilization or recognized revenue.
rows.model_impact: Catalyst and capex risk; only conditional earnings credit.
rows.gap: Units, schedule, utilization, customer allocation and ASP are undisclosed.

rows.claim: The market is crowded at the 2026-07-14 intraday price.
rows.evidence: Realtime price, 60-day return, turnover events, financing balance and LHB snapshots.
rows.formal_boundary: Crowding is a market-structure inference, not proof of manipulation or future direction.
rows.model_impact: Reduces market-anchor weight and raises entry discipline.
rows.gap: No complete beneficial-owner style flow decomposition is available.

rows.claim: The company formally previewed 2026H1 parent net profit of CNY2.90-3.00bn.
rows.evidence: Official announcement No. 2026-035, released 2026-07-14 16:35 and dated 2026-07-15.
rows.formal_boundary: Unaudited company-level range; final H1 report may differ.
rows.model_impact: Validates the lower bound of the 2026E denominator and raises the Q2 earnings threshold.
rows.gap: No optical segment revenue, gross margin, ASP, order or customer split.

rows.claim: The H1 preview implies Q2 parent net profit of CNY1.790-1.890bn.
rows.evidence: H1 preview range less Q1 reported parent net profit CNY1.1099bn.
rows.formal_boundary: Derived quarter bridge, not separately disclosed Q2 result.
rows.model_impact: The prior CNY1.65bn Q2 threshold is exceeded by the preview lower bound.
rows.gap: Q2 product and segment attribution remains unavailable.

rows.claim: The stock has a real institutional base in the latest official quarter-end holder table.
rows.evidence: HKSCC 3.79%; named insurance 3.05%; named public fund/ETF 2.03%; controller family 33.25%.
rows.formal_boundary: 2026-03-31 snapshot; not a live July ownership statement.
rows.model_impact: Supports institutional-base classification, not a target-price uplift.

rows.claim: The 2026-07-14 tape was active institutional/trading capital, not quiet one-way accumulation.
rows.evidence: Institutional LHB net buy CNY436.83m; Stock Connect net sell CNY326.47m; LHB turnover 29.67% of market turnover.
rows.formal_boundary: Seat-level and aggregate flow evidence; cannot identify named funds.
rows.model_impact: Classifies the stock as institutional base plus active-trading reinforcement.
